notes: Audit/reconciliation completed against dedicated skill pages. Gigantic Slam is explicitly a Strike Super, 100 Ki, and unavailable for CaC. Boulder Break and Boulder Toss are Great Ape Super Skills; their exact canonical subtype remains a research judgment recorded here as Strike pending stronger in-game stat evidence. Energy Cannon and Beam Rifle retain Ki Blast classification with unresolved Ki cost. Bloody Sauce is a Ki Blast Super costing 100 Ki; its dedicated page gives Expert Mission 20 as the skill unlock while Expert Mission 13 separately lists the Raid variant. Darkness Mixer and Pretty Charge are Other Supers and cast-exclusive. Giant Storm was added after dedicated current documentation confirmed Ultimate/Ki Blast classification, 300 Ki, Skill Shop unlock, and CaC availability.
